info.title: VidJutsu Cloud API
info.description: Video editing built for agents: upload takes, edit a timeline with history, and render it on cloud machines. The same operations are MCP tools at https://api.vidjutsu.ai/mcp.

parameters.name: VidJutsu-Version
parameters.description: The API version you wrote your integration against, a date. The current version is `2026-11-03`. See https://docs.vidjutsu.ai/api-reference/introduction#versioning.

bearer.description: A VidJutsu API key (`vj_live_...`) from POST /auth/verify or POST /keys, or an OAuth access token (MCP clients).

plan_version.description: The plan you're on, or null before you subscribe.

media_deletes_at.description: After a failed payment: when stored media will be deleted if the payment isn't made.

AccountStatus.description: `no_plan`: subscribe to start work. `active`: everything works. `payment_failed`: reads work, new work is paused until you update your card.

prefix.description: The key's first characters, to recognize it.

url.description: A Stripe-hosted page. Open it in a browser.

reused.description: Checkout only: an open checkout session was reused.

success_url.description: https URL to return to after paying.

cancel_url.description: https URL to return to if you cancel.

CleanAudio.description: Speech tracks (one per speaker) and an optional music bed, as stored media hashes. The cleaned, mixed result is added to your library as audio media.

music.description: Music bed kept under the voice.

music_db.description: Music level under the voice, dB.

CompleteUpload.description: Every part you sent, by number and ETag.

parts.description:
Every part, numbers 1 to the part count (empty when the start said
`already_stored`).

name.description: A label to recognize the key by.

EditProject.description: Edit operations applied to a branch head as one atomic commit. The body is a list of operations, or an object with `operations` and optionally `branch` and, for safe retries, `expected_head` and `idempotency_key`. Times are seconds (`12`, `"12.5"`) or fractions (`"1001/30000"`).

expected_head.description:
The head this edit was written against; a moved head is a conflict.
Absent: the current head.

operations.description: Edit operations, each named by `op`: `add_media`, `add_track`, `insert_clip`, `delete_clip`, `move_clip`, `trim_clip`, `swap_media`, `set_gain`, `set_fade`, `cut_pauses`, `set_layout`. Each operation sees the result of the ones before it. See https://docs.vidjutsu.ai/guides/editing.

Entitlements.description: `{"state": "available", "entitlements": {...}, "spend_limit_micros": ...}`: your plan's limits and features. Money is in micro-dollars.

Error.description: Every error has a stable `code` and a `message`. Billing and limit errors add the fields that tell you how to fix them. See https://docs.vidjutsu.ai/errors.

message.description: What went wrong, in plain words.

checkout_url.description: 402 with no plan: a Stripe Checkout link that starts Pro.

portal_url.description: 402 after a failed payment: a Stripe billing portal link to update your card.

media_deletes_at.description: After a failed payment: when your stored media will be deleted if the payment isn't made.

contact_url.description: 403 plan_limit: where to ask about Enterprise.

retry_after_seconds.description: 429: when to try again (also sent as a Retry-After header).

request_id.description: Your Idempotency-Key, or a generated id. Quote it when you contact support.

IngestUrl.description: An https link to add to your library.

name.description: File name for the media id; default: the link's last path part.

url.description: An `https://` link the server downloads (a presigned link works).

audio.description: A video's sound, as audio media.

conform_at_render.description: Whether the parts of this video a render uses are converted at render time (it is stored as uploaded).

converted.description: Whether the file was converted before storing (a still image becomes PNG).

InitProject.description: A project name and, optionally, a full manifest. Without one, the project starts empty with tracks `v1` (video) and `a1` (audio).

idempotency_key.description: Retrying with the same key returns the first result.

manifest.description: A full project manifest. Absent: an empty project with tracks `v1` (video) and `a1` (audio).

url.description: A fresh 7-day link on every read.

revision.description: Pinned when the job was created.

box_seconds.description: Machine time, from creation to stop.

final.description: The job has finished: these numbers will not change.

output_seconds.description: Length of the rendered film (null when it failed).

usage.description: What the job used, once boxes have run (also for failed and canceled jobs); null when none ran.

LevelAudio.description: Audio tracks to level, and the loudness to level them to.

manifest.description: The project manifest: media, tracks and clips.

RenderProject.description: What to render and how. Every field is optional.

boxes.description: Cap on machines for this render (default: chosen for you).

force.description: Render even if this exact output already exists.

hedge.description: Run slow ranges again on idle machines (default true).

loudness.description: Normalize the final mix to this integrated loudness (LUFS).

range_seconds.description: Length of each render range, in seconds (default 15).

revision.description: Render this revision instead of the branch head.

split.description: `cuts` (default): ranges follow clip boundaries, so later edits reuse untouched ranges; `grid`: fixed ranges from frame 0.

SentPart.description: One sent part: its number and the `ETag` header its PUT returned.

email.description: Where to send the sign-in code.

attempt.description: Send it back with the code to POST /auth/verify.

name.description: A name for the API key this creates.

api_key.description: `vj_live_...`. Shown once: keep it. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.

checkout_url.description: When `status` is `no_plan`: a Stripe Checkout link that starts Pro.

StartUpload.description: The file's name, exact length and SHA-256.

bytes.description: The file's exact length in bytes.

name.description: File name for the media id (`take1.mov` becomes media `take1`).

sha256.description:
The file's SHA-256, 64 lowercase hex digits. The server checks the
stored bytes against it before keeping them.

already_stored.description: The hash is already stored: send no parts, just complete.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds when the part links stop working.

part_size.description: Bytes in every part but the last (the rest).

Usage.description: This billing period's usage of each meter (render minutes up to 1080p, render minutes above 1080p, storage), what's left of your included allowance, and the spend so far. `{"state": "unavailable"}` when it can't be read right now.
